uncoveredBranches.uncoveredReason: No authoritative retained evidence proves recovery when a response is lost after persistence succeeds; services/persistenceTransition.ts only persists and then commits local success.
uncoveredBranches.recommendedAction: Add an authorized disposable server test that commits durable state, drops the response, retries with the same idempotency identity, and proves exact recovery with zero duplicate effects.

provenance.limitation: services/persistenceTransition.ts defines persist-before-local-success ordering but no response-loss simulation, replay, or recovery contract.
